statements.t: We will protect the strength of our core business, improve returns from our operations and invest where we see the best opportunities to create value.
The Company is introducing fiscal 2027 consolidated net sales guidance of $1,440 million to $1,470 million.
The Company anticipates its fiscal 2027 adjusted EBITDA to be between $378 million and $388 million.
At the midpoint of the guidance range, the Company expects to achieve an adjusted EBITDA margin of 26.3% for the year, reflecting a 110 basis point year-over-year improvement.

The Company anticipates the second half of fiscal 2027 adjusted EBITDA margin will be higher than the first half, driven primarily by the seasonality of net sales, benefits from portfolio optimization and operational improvements.
The Company expects free cash flow as a percentage of adjusted net income to be more than 80% in fiscal 2027.
A live webcast of the call will be available on the Investor Relations section of the Company’s website.
